node.title: A regular pencil-free3 kernel map has generic fibre1 and an exceptional fibre3
node.statement: Over characteristic0 or p>7, U=span(1,X^3-X,X^4-X^2), with T cycling this basis, gives W={(f,Tf)} of pair/shared dimensions3/3, full generic projection and everywhere-finite joint rank2, with no rank-one plane. Its kernel map d=(v-w^2,vw-1,w-v^2) has a rational inverse generically but exact fibre {-1,0,1} over [0:1:0]. Thus generic degree alone cannot be used as a uniform fibre/intersection cap. This is not an official large-agreement source or Prize counterexample.
